name: memory_fact_assert
description: Assert a bitemporal fact (subject-predicate-object triple) into the cognitive memory graph with validity intervals and confidence.

object.description: Target entity name or literal value.

valid_from.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the fact became true in the real world. Defaults to current epoch second.

valid_to.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) until when the fact remains true. Defaults to infinity (Long.MAX_VALUE).

confidence.description: Subjective epistemic confidence in this assertion (0.0 to 1.0). Default 1.0.

allow_coexisting.description: Whether to allow multiple conflicting facts with overlapping validity intervals. Default false.

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.
